# DeepKids — EscapeGravity

> EscapeGravity is an educational science board game for kids ages 7+, made by DeepKids. Players race a board piece toward the International Space Station while fighting "Gravity" using Force Cards earned by completing real, physical, hands-on challenges — learning concepts like gravity, forces, and air resistance by doing them, not just reading about them. 2–6 players, ~30 minute average playtime.

## Product
- Ages: 7+
- Players: 2–6
- Average playtime: 30 minutes
- Core mechanic: physical challenge cards unlock force cards used to counter "gravity" on a spiral board, racing toward the ISS.
- Category: educational board game, STEM toy, science learning game for kids, family board game (India).
